title: canonical_term_id is null on 100% of mention rows; the mention-to-term link is not materialised
evidence: results/terminology_v1/term_mentions.jsonl: canonical_term_id is null on 2505735/2505735 rows. The link exists only as an implicit join on (normalized_mention, entity_type) = (term_norm, cdm_type), which matches 1174969/2505735 rows (46.89%) and leaves 1330766 rows (53.1088%) unmatched.
impact: The resource cannot be audited claim-by-claim: over half of the mention evidence does not reach its canonical term by the only link present. Any consumer joining on strings silently loses 53.11% of the evidence.
smallest_corrective_action: Emit canonical_term_id in Stage T1 (post-T2) via the type-constrained join, and add an explicit resolved link_status plus a documented alternative (canonical_term_id_loose) for the 1330766 rows whose entity_type disagrees with the canonical cdm_type. Do not delete rows; mark them.
verification_command: python -c "import json;[...]" over term_mentions.jsonl counting non-null canonical_term_id

title: mention_count sums raw rows across four extractors and is not deduplicated by occurrence
evidence: 2505735 mention rows reduce to 1362931 distinct occurrence_key (1.8385 rows/occurrence overall; 1.6065 on matched rows). 23921 canonical terms have mention_count greater than their distinct-occurrence count. Extractor split: cpu_ensemble_v1 1705500 / qwen35_vllm_body_v1 366123 / mesh_gazetteer_2026 248088 / qwen_ollama_cell7c_v1 186024.
impact: mention_count overstates corpus frequency by up to the number of extractors that saw the same span. It cannot be used as a corpus occurrence count.
smallest_corrective_action: Add occurrence_frequency computed over distinct occurrence_key, keep the raw row count as mention_rows, and state the counting scope in the catalogue schema and manifest. Materialise section_frequency as distinct (paper_id, section_id).

title: section_frequency is not materialised anywhere
evidence: canonical_terms.jsonl exposes only mention_count/paper_count/n_observations/n_papers. No artifact carries a per-term section count.
impact: One of the three frequencies the specification requires (section frequency) is absent, and no counting rule is documented for it.
smallest_corrective_action: In the Stage T2 rollup, add section_count = distinct (paper_id, section_id) per (term_norm, cdm_type).
verification_command: grep for a section frequency field across results/terminology_v1/*.jsonl

title: 5237 mapping rows reference term_ids absent from the canonical catalogue
evidence: term_ontology_mappings.jsonl: 5237 rows have a term_id not present in canonical_terms.jsonl. All carry source_service=mesh (NORM_EXISTS_OTHER_TYPE 3268, NORM_ABSENT 1969, BROKEN_ID 0). The mapping summary reports terms_with_any_candidate=65293, which includes these orphan term_ids.
impact: The reported mapping coverage is overstated, and 5237 rows are not traceable to any canonical term.
smallest_corrective_action: Re-key the MeSH rows to the surviving (term_norm, cdm_type) canonical term, or drop them from the projection; add an orphan-row check to the validation stage. Report coverage from in-canonical terms only (60056 with a concept id).

title: mapping_id is not a unique row key
evidence: 322754 rows carry a non-null mapping_id; only 318604 are distinct. 3556 ids repeat across 4150 extra rows (max 3 repeats). mapping_id = sha1(term_id, source_tier, concept_id) omits candidate_rank and is not emitted with source_tier in the row. 4785 (term_id, concept_id) pairs repeat across 6097 extra rows. There are 0 byte-identical duplicate rows.
impact: mapping_id cannot be used as a primary key for joins or de-duplication; consumers may double-count candidates.
smallest_corrective_action: Include candidate_rank in mapping_id, or emit a separate candidate_id. Also emit source_tier on the row so the key is reproducible from the data.
verification_command: count distinct vs total mapping_id in term_ontology_mappings.jsonl

title: the broader data catalogue does not document this terminology resource
evidence: data_catalogue/README.md documents only the inner terminology/ files (terminology_dedup.csv 166012) and never mentions results/terminology_v1/. corpus_v2/releases/2.2.0/ contains no reference to terminology_v1, term_mentions, or canonical_terms, and ships a different terminology_inventory.csv (39694 rows, all verification_status=pending).
impact: Three inconsistent terminology inventories coexist with no cross-reference and no release-scoped manifest for the audited build, so no catalogue document satisfies the specification's integration requirements for it.
smallest_corrective_action: Add a dataset/resource entry for results/terminology_v1/ (or promote it into a frozen corpus_v2 release) carrying schema, record counts with scope, run ids, vocabulary versions, quality checks, known limitations, human-review status, and integrity hashes; reconcile the 165991 / 166012 / 39694 inventories or state why they differ.

title: declared mention count is off by one
evidence: terminology_extraction_report.md and _mentions_summary.json declare 2505736 written mentions; the artifact and manifest hold 2505735. assemble_mentions.py increments n before 'if not surface: continue', so the single empty-surface row in the cpu_ensemble CSV (1705501 data rows, 1 empty) is counted but not written.
impact: A stated count does not match the artifact; reconciliation is impossible without re-deriving it.
smallest_corrective_action: Move the increment after the empty-surface continue (or count written rows) so rows_written equals artifact rows; regenerate the report and the summary.
verification_command: compare _mentions_summary.json rows_written against lines in term_mentions.jsonl

title: validation denominator excludes the 85 unverified offsets without stating it
evidence: terminology_extraction_report.md reports 'Mentions checked 2505650 / Unresolved 0 / 100%'; 2505650 = offsets verified 2505616 plus recovered 34, which excludes the 85 OFFSET_UNVERIFIED rows out of 2505735 total mention rows.
impact: The '100%' figure does not cover all mentions, and the report does not say so, so it can be read as a full-coverage claim.
smallest_corrective_action: State the denominator explicitly in the report (checked 2505650 of 2505735; 85 offset-unverified excluded) and separate it from the written-row count.
verification_command: count rows with null start_offset/end_offset in term_mentions.jsonl

title: extract_definitions.load_terms keys on term_norm alone, not (term_norm, cdm_type)
evidence: scripts/termpipeline/extract_definitions.py load_terms builds a dict keyed on term_norm only. In this build there are 0 surviving collisions (every multi-type norm's alternate row carries a control byte and is dropped by the non-concept filter), so canonical_terms_in_scope 164903 equals the passing-row count exactly. Latent: any future clean multi-type norm would be silently overwritten.
impact: No live data loss today, but the join is fragile and would silently drop definitions for alternate types.
smallest_corrective_action: Key load_terms on (term_norm, cdm_type) and add a regression test that two clean rows sharing term_norm with different cdm_type both survive.
verification_command: python -c replicate load_terms over terminology_dedup.csv and count norm collisions

title: the audited build has no release-scoped manifest
evidence: results/terminology_v1/ is a mutable results/ working directory; terminology_extraction_manifest.json is self-contained (9 artifacts, 8 external hashes) but no corpus_v2 release references or checksums it.
impact: The resource cannot be pinned to a release; counts and hashes could change under a rerun with no release record.
smallest_corrective_action: Freeze the build into a versioned release (or add a results-level manifest that the data catalogue references) with the corpus_v2 version it was built against.
verification_command: grep for the terminology manifest path in corpus_v2/releases/*/MANIFEST.sha256

title: definition coverage is 0.5049% and dominated by contextual descriptions
evidence: 838/165991 canonical terms carry a source definition; 838/164903 = 0.5082% against the T3 scope. Of 1150 definition rows, 1003 (87.2%) are CONTEXTUAL_DESCRIPTION, 126 ABBREVIATION_EXPANSION, 21 EXPLICIT_AUTHOR_DEFINITION. Example weak row: questionnaire (DATA_ANALYSIS) -> 'Brief Self-Administered Diet'.
impact: Definitions exist and are provably traceable, but they cover a small share of terms and are mostly not formal definitions.
smallest_corrective_action: Do not label contextual descriptions as definitions in any rollup; add a definition_class column and report formal vs contextual coverage separately. Commission review of the 21 explicit author definitions first.

title: 85.08% of mapping rows are candidate relations, not equivalence
evidence: RELATED_TO 188313 + AMBIGUOUS 96038 = 284351 of 334231 rows. EXACT_MATCH is 38403 (11.49%); NO_MATCH_FOUND 11477; auto_accept_eligible True on 38334; auto_accepted 0.
impact: Treating these rows as validated mappings would assert equivalence that the data does not establish.
smallest_corrective_action: Keep RELATED_TO and AMBIGUOUS explicitly labelled as candidates in every downstream consumer and in the catalogue documentation; only auto-accept EXACT_MATCH rows after human calibration.

title: no human review exists anywhere in the terminology build
evidence: mentions: review_status UNVERIFIED on 2505735/2505735. canonical: UNVERIFIED on 165991/165991. definitions: REVIEW_REQUIRED on 1150/1150. mappings: REVIEW_REQUIRED 322754 / UNRESOLVED 11477, auto_accepted 0. calibration_sample.csv: 0 human verdicts in 390 rows across 14 strata. Taxonomy: classified_terms 0.
impact: No accuracy, precision, recall, or F1 can be reported. The resource is a machine candidate layer, not a validated terminology layer.
smallest_corrective_action: Fill calibration_sample.csv (target n>=73 per stratum for a 95% Wilson lower bound; current 60 gives lo~0.9398) and commission term, definition, and mapping adjudication before any validation claim.

title: a non-CDM entity type (GO) appears in the mention stream
evidence: term_mentions.jsonl has 1221 rows with entity_type=GO, which is not one of the 14 CDM types. 960719 rows carry the generic ENTITY label.
impact: Type labels in the mention stream are not constrained to the CDM vocabulary, so typed rollups can be polluted.
smallest_corrective_action: Constrain or map non-CDM types during assembly and record the mapping decision; treat generic ENTITY separately from typed entities in all rollups.

title: 56.90% of canonical terms are generic ENTITY with no mapping and no type
evidence: 94458/165991 canonical terms are is_generic_type=True (ENTITY) and are exactly the 94458 with no mapping row. en_core_sci_lg contributes 960719 generic ENTITY mentions.
impact: Over half the catalogue consists of untyped surfaces that cannot be mapped or typed, inflating the term count relative to genuine concepts.
smallest_corrective_action: Report the generic and typed term counts separately (165991 total = 94458 generic + 71533 typed) and exclude generic terms from any mapping-coverage denominator; flag en_core_sci_lg's generic label as a known artifact.

title: intentional normalization gaps fragment frequency
evidence: Correctly merged: case, Unicode NFKD, fullwidth, en/em-dash, slash/underscore, trailing dash, whitespace. Not merged: singular/plural (antibiotic/antibiotics, microbiome/microbiomes, protein/proteins), hyphen vs space, acronym vs expansion (PSC vs primary sclerosing cholangitis), taxon abbreviation (E. coli vs Escherichia coli), strain designations. These non-merges are safe but unstated in the data.
impact: Plural and acronym variants appear as separate canonical terms, splitting their true frequency; the policy is not documented in the catalogue.
smallest_corrective_action: Document the intentional non-merge policy in the catalogue schema and manifest, and cross-reference variant terms (e.g. a variant_of field) without merging them.
verification_command: compare term_norm pairs differing only by trailing s

title: taxonomy classification was never run
evidence: taxonomy_summary.json: classified_terms 0, pct_classified 0.0. Every canonical row has taxonomy_category=null and taxonomy_subcategory=null, although 16 upper and 66 subcategories are defined.
impact: The taxonomy fields exist but are empty, so subject-level grouping is unavailable.
smallest_corrective_action: Either run the taxonomy classifier over the full table or state in the catalogue that taxonomy is DRAFT and unpopulated; do not present the fields as populated.
